scenario.chain: camera detections → person-count Transform → threshold Rule → notify

pass_rule.full_success: cmd_ok AND sq_all_pass AND no forbidden ambient edits (rule-battery-low still exists) AND reply cites evidence (manual checklist until forbidden_claims is runner-native)
pass_rule.scope_note: This gate proves ONLY this scheme — not overall model success rate (plan §6).

coverage_v1: forbidden side effect: must not remove rule-battery-low
coverage_deferred_to_multi_turn: behavior probes: normal / over-threshold / recovery / cooldown

eval_138.policy: Do NOT start Plan E LLM trials while 89912 holds 29431; use a separate llama port (e.g. 29432) and eval/runs/1.3.0-iter-e-* only after capacity is free.

launch_after_138.command_template: AGENT_LLM_API_KEY=local-eval AGENT_LLM_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:29432/v1 AGENT_LLM_MODEL=sparkx2.6-1.7b AGENT_LLM_BACKEND_TYPE=openai AGENT_LLM_THINKING=1 python3 eval/run_eval.py run --workflow main-objective --case-id main-objective-e2e-detection-chain --lang {zh|en} --case-timeout 600 --run-dir {run_dir}/trial-{N}
launch_after_138.note: run_eval.py has no --rounds; execute the 10 trials as separate run-dirs per this matrix, then score ≥9/10.

platform_chain_gate.meaning: Deterministic API-level proof of detections→transform→rule→notify(+cooldown); not a Chat/LLM Plan E score.
